sloka: पितामहस्तु मामाह तवाहारः सुदेवज ।स्वादूनि स्वानि मांसानि तानि भक्षय नित्यशः ।। ७.७८.१४ ॥
transliteration: pitāmahastu māmāha tavāhāraḥ sudevaja ।svādūni svāni māṁsāni tāni bhakṣaya nityaśaḥ ।। 7.78.14 ॥

translations.english: The grandfather, Brahma, then told me, "O son of a good god, your food shall be your own delicious flesh, which you must eat constantly."
